items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: The name 'Xavier' is mentioned only by the interviewer in the prompt: 'well we talked about Xavier'. The interviewee does not mention Xavier in their response, instead discussing their post-war options and early career.

ctx.x: schools colleges or universities the first thing I do ask the simple question what is the most important product that you're using right now Ted what's the most important product you're using right now no no an intangible something you can't see T-I-M-E time it's intangible something you can't see your intellect you're using that too but unless God gives you the time you wouldn't be able to use that intellect that's what I'm talking about so that's the beauty part of living accomplishing something doing something…

my time if they want to waste their time well we are Ted well we talked about Xavier and I guess you were through the army the army yeah well so what what while you're in the army were you contemplating what you were going to do when the war was over or what what you were going to do when you got out

no I I was thinking about doing a period of segregation what options I had become a minister or work in the post office go back to school and study medicine or become an athlete those are the three or four options that I had but it just so happened that when I got out of the service I went back to work on the riverfront because my mother took sick and that's why I was a little heavy and then I started rolling rubber no I started digging salt in the car boxes you know that stuff that looked like ice cream salt…
